text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a meta-analysis reviewing the impacts of agricultural land conversion (ALC) on ecosystem services (ES) losses globally. The study does not implement national-scale spatial LULC prediction models, does not include multiple future scenarios, nor does it provide spatially explicit LULC projections or accuracy metrics. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction studies and does not meet the criteria for a review of LULC future prediction.)
